The Vic UI archive is built from `jerynv/vic-ui` commit `f156af1c10bd61ad3198cf0d368ee76a6b76d687`. It includes the native fields, radio, select, disclosure, skeleton, shared overlay surfaces and native scrolling used by Phaethon. It excludes that checkout’s unrelated pending edits to `MAP.md`, `Textarea.tsx` and `ui-inputs.css`. The package and lockfile use a checked-in archive so a clean Phaethon checkout builds without a sibling repository or access to an unpublished commit.

To reproduce it, export that commit with `git archive` to a temporary directory, install its dependencies, run `npm run build`, `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` and `npm run check:design`, then run `npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination` pointing at this directory. Rename the archive `vic-ui-f156af1.tgz`. Keep Vic UI’s MIT licence and third-party notices inside the archive.

To update it, repeat the process from the chosen Vic UI commit, name the archive with its source commit, update Phaethon’s `vic-ui` dependency, and run `pnpm install` and `pnpm test`.
